string-array.name: thermal_sconfig_descriptions
string-array.item: Most restrictive thermal limits. Reduces heat and power consumption. Ideal for charging or prolonged light use.
Default daily use profile. Balanced between performance and temperature.
Optimized for continuous screen-on use like GPS navigation. Stable thermals over long sessions.
Tuned for gaming workloads. Allows higher sustained CPU/GPU clocks with controlled thermals.
Removes thermal throttling limits. Maximum performance but generates significant heat. Use with caution.
High performance profile for demanding tasks. Higher power and clock ceilings than Balanced.
Combines High Performance and Gaming profiles. Maximum sustained performance for intensive gaming sessions.

resources.string: Control CPU and touchpanel response behavior

string-array.name: thermal_balance_entries
string-array.item: Economy
Balanced
Performance

string-array.name: thermal_balance_descriptions
string-array.item: Reduces CPU response and touch report rate. Saves battery, less heat. Best for light use or charging.
Default mode. Standard CPU and touch response for everyday use.
Increases CPU response and touch report rate. Best for gaming or performance-intensive tasks.

string-array.name: zram_size_descriptions
string-array.item: Disable virtual memory swap. Best for maximum RAM speed on high-RAM variants.
Small swap size. Minimal background overhead.
Standard swap size. Good balance for daily multitasking.
Optimal swap size for 4GB/6GB RAM devices.
Aggressive swap size. Better multitasking at the cost of some CPU overhead.
Large swap size. Keeps more background apps alive.
Huge swap size. Recommended for power users and heavy gaming.
Ultra swap size. For massive multitasking scenarios.
Maximum swap size. Use only on highest storage/RAM variants.
